cases.name: authority_join
cases.required_behavior: Reject missing or wrong design/implementation review/adoption before any effect.

cases.name: unused_attempt
cases.required_behavior: Refuse occupied, unreadable or alias attempt; never delete/retry its claim.

cases.name: retained_pin_drift
cases.required_behavior: Refuse source/runtime/asset content or identity change before/during/after use.

cases.name: source_enumeration
cases.required_behavior: Refuse added/missing files and bounded census overflow; directory handles are not a membership freeze.

cases.name: path_and_writer
cases.required_behavior: Reject hardlinks, reparse/alias/outside paths and incompatible existing writers; protect outputs from writers/deletion.

cases.name: manifest_bounds
cases.required_behavior: Reject per-file,total,count,depth or report limits without partial acceptance.

cases.name: bootstrap_same_bytes
cases.required_behavior: Execute only externally bound, verified bootstrap bytes; fail changed helper after verification.

cases.name: runtime_abi
cases.required_behavior: Refuse stale .venv, incompatible ABI, missing declared extension/DLL/resource or package metadata.

cases.name: import_origin
cases.required_behavior: Refuse unlisted source, pyc/zip/.pth/site/startup/plugin/conftest paths and ambient environment injection.

cases.name: native_loader
cases.required_behavior: Refuse unknown DLL search directories/images; independently qualify platform trust exceptions.

cases.name: preimport_phase
cases.required_behavior: Confinement applies before package initialization; forbid unreviewed model/file/network/process effects.

cases.name: safetensors_alias
cases.required_behavior: Block load/save before by-value project binding and test every retained alias before candidates.

cases.name: required_guards
cases.required_behavior: Missing required symbol or unguarded equivalent operation fails; no hasattr-and-skip.

cases.name: candidate_zero_budget
cases.required_behavior: Any forbidden candidate action or nonzero/bool scientific counter fails even when pytest catches exception.

cases.name: control_names
cases.required_behavior: Require exactly34 successor controls, all exact Boolean true; identify two changed local-window semantics.

cases.name: collection_roster
cases.required_behavior: Require117 unique full IDs and25 exact counts, identical L/V roster; reject duplicate/missing/extra/deselected.

cases.name: phase_and_junit
cases.required_behavior: Require351 complete successful reports and matching physical117-case JUnit; reject skip/xfail/xpass/class/count mismatches.

cases.name: fixture_scope
cases.required_behavior: Restrict mutation/restore to owned JSON fixture paths; guard failure/crash cannot modify historical inputs.

cases.name: git_confinement
cases.required_behavior: Reject alternate executable,args,env,cwd; enforce per-call and whole-budget limits and owned Job membership.

cases.name: atomic_job_start
cases.required_behavior: Inject create/assignment/resume failures; never run uncontained; start uncertainty remains sticky.

cases.name: ownership_cleanup
cases.required_behavior: Verify original handles, exits, empty/closed Job and stream EOF where applicable; no PID-only ownership.

cases.name: resources_stop_time
cases.required_behavior: Exercise stop PRESENT/UNKNOWN, RAM/disk/cap/clock/deadline/work-reserve refusal; no deadline extension.

cases.name: result_handoff
cases.required_behavior: Prove child-result ownership/closure and parent create-new/readback; reject replacement/partial/missing output.

cases.name: caller_return
cases.required_behavior: A passing child or internal timestamp cannot substitute for genuine complete bounded external return.

cases.name: failure_preservation
cases.required_behavior: Preserve first failure, partial bytes and consumed UUID; cleanup cannot upgrade failed work.

cases.name: closeout_completeness
cases.required_behavior: Export only complete accepted local chain under64-file32MiB cap; metadata archive is not tests/runtime proof.
